body:
## Pull request overview

This PR enriches the **CRM example stack** to exercise more of the `@objectstack/spec` object/field/view capabilities end-to-end (as consumed by the Console), including richer field metadata, more field types, additional list views, and updated seed data and tests.

**Changes:**
- Added `description` and expanded field definitions across CRM objects (placeholders, help text, unique/readonly/defaults, and new fields/types like avatar/phone/richtext/color/multi-select).
- Expanded CRM list views (2+ per object) with additional columns/sorts/filters and updated seed data to populate new fields/values.
- Updated Console integration tests to align with the new CRM example metadata, and added a completion entry to `ROADMAP.md`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 12 out of 12 changed files in this pull request and generated 10 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| examples/crm/src/objects/account.object.ts | Adds object description + expands fields (placeholders/helpText, new multi-select tags, richtext description, readonly created_at). |
| examples/crm/src/objects/contact.object.ts | Adds description + expands fields (avatar/phone/richtext notes, status/priority option objects). |
| examples/crm/src/objects/opportunity.object.ts | Adds description + expands pipeline fields (forecast category, expected revenue, campaign source, richtext). |
| examples/crm/src/objects/product.object.ts | Adds description + expands catalog fields (unique SKU, tags multi-select, manufacturer/weight, richtext description). |
| examples/crm/src/objects/order.object.ts | Adds description + expands order fields (account/discount/shipping/tracking/richtext notes). |
| examples/crm/src/objects/user.object.ts | Adds description + expands profile fields (unique email/username, phone/avatar/bio, role option objects). |
| examples/crm/src/objects/project.object.ts | Adds description + expands task tracking fields (estimated/actual hours, assignee, richtext, color). |
| examples/crm/src/objects/event.object.ts | Adds description + expands calendar fields (all-day/private/reminder/status/organizer, richtext). |
| examples/crm/objectstack.config.ts | Adds/updates list views per object and updates seed data to match enriched schemas and new select values. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/ObjectGrid.test.tsx | Adjusts assertions for updated/normalized select display values. |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/ObjectForm.test.tsx | Updates expectations for default select values, richtext notes rendering, and phone input type. |
| ROADMAP.md | Adds roadmap entry documenting the CRM metadata enrichment milestone. |
</details>

The `closing_this_month` list view label implies a date-range filter, but the view currently has no `filter` at all (it’s identical to “All” except for columns/sort). Either add an actual filter for the current month (if supported by the filter DSL) or rename the view to match what it does.

`active_accounts` is filtered by `type = 'Customer'`. Given this PR’s shift to lowercase select values in multiple places, this is likely to become inconsistent if `account.type` is converted to lowercase identifiers. Consider aligning the filter literal with the actual option values used by `account.type` to avoid silent empty results.
```suggestion
          filter: ['type', '=', 'customer'],
```

`type` and `lead_source` still use the string-array select shorthand (e.g. "New Business", "Trade Show"). This conflicts with the PR description (lowercase identifiers + colored option objects) and is inconsistent with other updated selects in this PR. Recommend converting to `{ value, label, color }` options and aligning seed data.

The roadmap entry references the field option as `readOnly`, but the spec-aligned field metadata property used in this repo is `readonly` (with `readOnly` only as a compatibility alias). Consider updating the text to `readonly` to avoid documenting the wrong API surface.
```suggestion
Enriched all 8 CRM object definitions (`account`, `contact`, `opportunity`, `product`, `order`, `user`, `project_task`, `event`) to exercise the full `@objectstack/spec` feature set. Added `description` to all objects; field enrichments (`required`, `searchable`, `unique`, `defaultValue`, `helpText`, `placeholder`, `readonly`); diverse field types (`richtext`, `phone`, `avatar`, `color`, `multi-select`); 30+ new fields (tags, linkedin, expected_revenue, shipping_address, etc.); 2+ list views per object with sort/filter; select options with colors across all objects; updated seed data leveraging new fields.
```

The `industry` select still uses the string-array shorthand with capitalized values. This conflicts with the PR description (colored option objects + lowercase identifiers) and makes option values inconsistent with the other enriched selects. Consider switching to the object option format with explicit lowercase `value`s and (optionally) `color`, and update any seeds/filters accordingly.

`type` uses string-array options and `defaultValue: 'Customer'`, which is inconsistent with the new lowercase/value-object selects used elsewhere in the CRM enrichment. If the intent is spec-aligned lowercase identifiers + colored options, convert these options to `{ value, label, color }` and align `defaultValue`, views filters, and seed data to those values.

`lead_source` is still using the string-array select shorthand (mixed case + spaces like "Trade Show"). This contradicts the PR’s stated goal of lowercase identifier values and colored option objects. Recommend switching to the object option format and updating seeds to use the new lowercase values.

`expected_revenue` is marked `readonly` and documented as “Amount × Probability”, but it’s defined as a plain currency field. This will become stale whenever `amount`/`probability` change. Since `Field.formula(...)` exists in the codebase (see kitchen sink example), consider making this a formula field so the value is actually derived and the example exercises the spec’s computed field capability.
```suggestion
    expected_revenue: Field.formula('amount * probability', Field.currency({ label: 'Expected Revenue', readonly: true, helpText: 'Amount × Probability' })),
```

`payment_method` is still using the string-array select shorthand with spaced/capitalized values. If this example is meant to validate spec constraints and exercise colored select options, it should use explicit `{ value, label, color }` options (with lowercase identifier values) and update the seed records accordingly.
